# tenarium Provider

Manages tenants, plans and tenant configuration in a Tenarium control plane.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    tenarium = {
      source = "aimtune/tenarium"
    }
  }
}

# endpoint and api_key default to TENARIUM_URL and TENARIUM_API_KEY.
provider "tenarium" {
  endpoint = "https://tenarium.example.com"
  api_key  = var.tenarium_api_key
}

variable "tenarium_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) API key sent as a bearer token. Defaults to the `TENARIUM_API_KEY` environment variable.
- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the Tenarium API, e.g. `https://tenarium.example.com`. Defaults to the `TENARIUM_URL` environment variable.
